content: Shaqq-i Qamar explicates Quran 54:1 (the Hour has drawn nigh, the moon is split) on seven levels of interpretation arranged as an intellectual hierarchy: hadith scholars and jurists (lowest), dialectical theologians, peripatetic philosophers, illuminationist philosophers, verifying Sufis, lettrists, and at the top the men of might and vision, i.e. the Imams and their heirs, masters of jafr.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
